summary.text: Rob Bishop is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 6 and is seeking election to a full term in the November 3, 2026, general election.
He represented Utah's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House from 2003 to 2021 and earlier served in the Utah House from 1979 to 1994.

paragraphs.text: Bishop earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Utah and taught history and government at the high school level for 28 years.
He served in the Utah House of Representatives from 1979 to 1994, including as Speaker from 1992 to 1994.
Bishop represented Utah's 1st Congressional District until 2021, after announcing in July 2019 that he would retire.
In Congress he chaired the Natural Resources Committee and served on the Armed Services Committee.
The Republican Party of Utah appointed him to the Utah House of Representatives District 6 on April 25, 2026, to replace Matt Gwynn.
